facts.statement: SOE's Podcast #59 included an interview with Free Realms Community Manager Jason "Pex" Ryan about Free Realms.
facts.quote: Podcast #59 has all of the usual goodies with plenty of news, listener e-mails, and general chatter. Plus, this week features an interview with Free Realms Community Manager Jason "Pex" Ryan!

article_summaries.title: SOE Podcast Features Free Realms
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer news post announcing that SOE's Podcast #59 includes an interview with Free Realms Community Manager Jason "Pex" Ryan about the game. The article itself gives no game mechanics, quest, item or price details; it was posted before the April 2009 launch. The sidebar on the page lists the game's release date as April 28, 2009, but that is template data rather than article text.
